_about: Forecast roster. Owner IDs, emails and isActive verified live against HubSpot owners/users 2026-09-25. The app re-validates isActive and user seat on every data pull and flags any drift.

roles.ae: Edits own row in Section 1 and own builder in Section 2. Reads every row, builder, and trend (decision 2026-09-25: full transparency).
roles.ae_leader: Same as ae (edits own row and builder only).
roles.admin: Leadership access plus editing any AE's builder tags, submitting on behalf of any AE, and editor-run admin functions (installTriggers, refreshDataTrigger, debugSampleAe, verifySnapshots, seedSyntheticSnapshots in test mode).
